# Personal crontab for james
# Do not edit while the backup is running

SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
MAILTO=

# nightly database backup
0 3 * * * /usr/local/bin/backup.sh >> /var/log/backup.log 2>&1

# every quarter hour, output discarded on purpose
*/15 * * * * /usr/local/bin/heartbeat.sh > /dev/null 2>&1

# disabled while we investigate the disk usage
#30 4 * * 0 /usr/local/bin/vacuum.sh >> /var/log/vacuum.log 2>&1

@daily /usr/local/bin/rotate.sh
@reboot /usr/local/bin/warmup.sh
